name: file-scaffolder
description: Creates directory structures and files from a JSON template. Deterministic — no LLM needed.

inputs.name: Target Directory
inputs.description: Path to the target directory where files/dirs will be created

inputs.name: Template
inputs.description: JSON template with structure array: [{path, type (dir|file), content}]

outputs.name: Success
outputs.description: Whether all files/dirs were created successfully

outputs.name: Created Items
outputs.description: List of created files and directories
